zh.title: 美眾院委員會籲限制對中國航空業投資 點名空中巴士合約
zh.summary: 美國眾議院中國問題特別委員會建議限制對中國航空業投資，並籲美方停止核發中國製飛機的認證。報告也點名空中巴士，建議把企業對中國航空產業的投資納入美國政府合約審查。
body: 美國眾議院中國問題特別委員會11月19日發布航空產業調查報告。路透與 AeroTime 報導，委員會建議美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）不予認證中國製飛機，並限制對中國航空產業的投資。
委員會主張，西方業者與中方的部分合作有助於中國發展軍用航空能力。報告提出，若相關承包商繼續投資中國航空產業，美方應撤回政府合約。路透指出，空中巴士是報告點名的企業之一。
報告提出的認證與採購限制仍屬政策建議，須由美國政府採取後續措施才會生效。

en.title: U.S. House panel urges restrictions on China aerospace investment and scrutiny of Airbus contracts
en.summary: A U.S. House committee recommended tighter limits on investment in China’s aerospace industry and urged the FAA to withhold certification of Chinese-built aircraft.
body: The U.S. House Select Committee on China released an aerospace industry investigation on November 19. Reuters and AeroTime reported that the panel urged Washington to restrict investment in China’s aerospace sector and called on the FAA to withhold certification of Chinese-built aircraft.

The committee argued that some Western aerospace partnerships had benefited China’s military aviation sector. Reuters reported that the panel recommended pulling U.S. government contracts from aerospace contractors that continue investing in the sector and identified Airbus among the companies affected by the proposal.
The proposed certification and procurement restrictions would require further U.S. government action before taking effect.

facts.claim: The House panel released an investigation into Western aerospace partnerships with China on November 19.
The panel recommended restricting investment and withholding certification of Chinese-built aircraft. It named Airbus in connection with proposed contractual restrictions.
